sections.title: France: An Artistic & Cultural Journey
sections.subtitle: Introduction
sections.html:
France: An Artistic & Cultural Journey

Experience the rich artistic and cultural heritage of France on a journey through Paris, the Loire Valley, Brittany, Normandy, and Giverny. Explore iconic landmarks, historic villages, and world-renowned art, while enjoying regional cuisine, workshops, and immersive local traditions.

sections.title: Day 1 - Welcome to Paris
sections.html:
Arrive in Paris and settle in

Arrive in Paris and settle in. Enjoy time at leisure to explore the neighborhood, discover a café, or take an evening stroll through the French capital.

sections.title: Day 2 - Chartres & the Loire Valley
sections.html:
Travel from Paris toward the Loire Valley

Travel from Paris toward the Loire Valley. Stop in Chartres for a guided visit of its celebrated Gothic cathedral and the famous labyrinth. Discover the extraordinary mosaic-covered Maison Picassiette before continuing to the Loire Valley.

sections.title: Day 3 - Châteaux, Art & Wine in the Loire
sections.html:
Visit Château de Chenonceau

Visit the elegant Château de Chenonceau, spanning the River Cher.

Regional Wine Tasting

Enjoy a regional wine tasting.

Explore Château du Clos Lucé

Explore Château du Clos Lucé, Leonardo da Vinci’s final residence, and its creative legacy.

Dinner at Clos Lucé

Dinner is planned at Clos Lucé.

sections.title: Day 4 - Carnac & Brittany
sections.html:
Head west into Brittany and discover Carnac

Head west into Brittany and discover Carnac, renowned for its remarkable prehistoric standing stones, on a guided visit. Continue into the Breton countryside and enjoy a relaxing evening.

sections.title: Day 5 - Pont-Aven: In the Footsteps of Gauguin
sections.html:
Discover Pont-Aven, the artists’ village

Discover Pont-Aven, the picturesque artists’ village associated with Paul Gauguin and the Pont-Aven School. Enjoy a guided walk through the village and its galleries, visit the Musée de Pont-Aven, and take part in an art workshop.

sections.title: Day 6 - Legends & Traditions of Brocéliande
sections.html:
Immerse yourself in Brittany’s folklore

Immerse yourself in Brittany’s folklore with a visit to the Château de Comper and a storytelling walk inspired by the legend of the fairy Viviane. Explore Paimpont and the interactive Porte des Secrets experience.

Visit a traditional forge for a blacksmith demonstration

Visit a traditional forge for a blacksmith demonstration.

Breton galette-making demonstration and festive regional dinner

Enjoy a Breton galette-making demonstration followed by a festive regional dinner with traditional music and dancing.

sections.title: Day 7 - Dinan & Mont-Saint-Michel
sections.html:
Travel through historic Dinan

Travel through historic Dinan, with time for lunch, before continuing to magnificent Mont-Saint-Michel.

Explore Mont-Saint-Michel and its medieval abbey

Explore this extraordinary tidal-island village and its medieval abbey.

Continue to Bayeux in Normandy

Continue to Bayeux in Normandy.

sections.title: Day 8 - Normandy: Flavors & D-Day History
sections.html:
Cheese-making visit and tasting

Discover Normandy’s culinary traditions with a cheese-making visit and tasting.

Guided exploration of the D-Day landing beaches

Continue with a guided exploration of the D-Day landing beaches and the region’s moving World War II history.

sections.title: Day 9 - Bayeux Tapestry and Monet’s Giverny
sections.html:
Visit the renowned Bayeux Tapestry

Visit the renowned Bayeux Tapestry.

Travel to Giverny to discover Claude Monet’s house and gardens

Travel to Giverny to discover Claude Monet’s house and gardens, a living source of Impressionist inspiration.

Art workshop in Giverny

An art workshop is planned in Giverny before returning to Paris.

sections.title: Day 10 - Paris at Your Own Pace
sections.html:
Free day in Paris

Enjoy a free day in Paris to visit museums, browse galleries, shop, or explore favorite neighborhoods.

Special dinner at the Eiffel Tower

Conclude the journey with a special dinner experience at the Eiffel Tower, as envisioned in the original program.
